style: factual clickbait for China finance audience

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一

subtitles.zh: 我们看到许多中国公司，包括特斯拉，都推出了自己的人形机器人。

subtitles.en: What sets iron apart? Well, we're happy to be back in the show.

subtitles.zh: 与市场上其他类人机器人相比，它实际上是一个非常不同的产品。

subtitles.zh: 第一，我称之为最像人的类人机器人。
subtitles.en: One, it's actually, I would call it the most human-like human robot.

subtitles.zh: 它实际上是一个具有人类尺寸、人类外形、人类姿态以及人类智能的机器人。
subtitles.en: It is actually a robot that has a human size, human figure, human posture, as well as human intelligence.

subtitles.zh: 我们的目标是在我们所说的人类商业环境中交付和部署这款机器人。
subtitles.en: It's a robot that we aim to deliver a deploy in what we call the human commercial environment.

subtitles.en: You mentioned that deployment schedule is for internal scenarios next year.

subtitles.zh: 上半年会是我们内部门店，可能还有办公室等作为导览。

subtitles.zh: 下半年，我们计划看向外部交付。
subtitles.en: And then the second half, we aim to look at, you know, export external delivery as well.

subtitles.zh: 我还想说的是，这也是我们旨在完成通用任务的机器人。
subtitles.en: What I also want to say is that this is also a robot that we aim to do general common purpose task.

subtitles.zh: 它不是只为了做单一任务。

briefs.speaker: Brian Gu
briefs.current_title: 小鹏顾宏地：机器人毛利高于汽车，明年交付量级可达数万台？

subtitles.zh: 好的，那么Iron在哪些技能上表现更优呢，Brian？拥有汽车业务又有何帮助，无论是通过行程、芯片，还是共享AI和共享工厂？
subtitles.en: Okay, so what sort of skills can Iron do better, maybe Brian? And how does having a car business help, whether it's through sheer trips, chips, I should say, shared AI and shared factories, too?

subtitles.zh: 我认为这些都是优势，因为首先，我们能够开发Iron，实际上是基于我们为智能电动汽车的自动驾驶技术所开发的物理AI核心。
subtitles.en: Well, I think it's all of the buff, because first of all, the reason that we actually are able to develop Iron is actually build upon our physical AI core that we have developed for autonomous driving technology in Smart EV.

subtitles.zh: 如你所知，我们一直在开发全栈能力，拥有自己的芯片、自己的模型、自己的训练工具以及AI基础设施，来训练真正推进模型所需的数据。
subtitles.en: As you know, we have been developing full stack capabilities, actually having our own chip, our own model, our own training tools as well as the AI infrastructure to train the data that necessary for, you know, really advancing the model.

subtitles.zh: 因此，这种能力加上我们作为电动汽车制造商，我们拥有先进的制造能力来管理大型复杂供应链，并理解动力总成的需求，真正以机器人形式呈现。
subtitles.en: So that really, you know, capability coupled with as a EV in our manufacturer, we actually have advanced manufacturing ability to manage large sophisticated supply chain as well as understanding the power train needs to, you know, really in

subtitles.zh: 所以所有这些能力，我认为都与我们的核心电动汽车业务以及我们正在开发的自动驾驶栈非常协同。
subtitles.en: So all of those capability, I would say, a very synergistic to our core EV business as well as the autonomous driving stack that we're developing.

subtitles.zh: 是的，Iron将于明年第二季度上市，Brian，你还说过，在机器人方面，它们实际上可以比汽车获得更高的利润率。
subtitles.en: Yeah, so Iron goes on sale, second quarter of next year, Brian, you've also said that when it comes to robots that they can actually earn higher margins than cars.

subtitles.zh: 你如何看待销量爬坡的形势？你认为机器人何时会成为你收入中更有意义的部分？

subtitles.zh: 我认为，明年将是规模扩大和商业化的关键一年。

subtitles.zh: 但硬件的利润增长要高得多。
subtitles.en: But it was much higher margin growth margin for the hardware.

subtitles.zh: 此外，机器人业务需要大量升级训练和数据基础设施支持。
subtitles.en: But in addition, I would say robot because it requires a lot of the upgrade training as well as data infrastructure support.

subtitles.zh: 我认为除了销售之外，还有可观的收入机会。
subtitles.en: I think there's meaningful revenue opportunities outside of how we're sell.

subtitles.zh: 所以，我认为这是我们看到的业务增长曲线中非常令人兴奋的部分。
subtitles.en: So that's, I would say a very exciting part of the business world's curve that we see.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这是商业世界曲线中非常令人兴奋的部分。我也想听听你对自动驾驶的看法，因为从明年第二季度开始，你们的AI智能驾驶也将向买家收取订阅费。
subtitles.en: So that's, I would say a very exciting part of the business world's curve that we see. I want to get your take on autonomous driving as well, because starting from second quarter of next year, your AI smart driving will also become a paid s

subtitles.zh: 能告诉我们为什么决定现在收费吗？你预期怎样的订阅率？
subtitles.en: Can you tell us why you decided to have sort of charging now? What sort of take rate are you expecting?

subtitles.zh: 首先，我认为这与我们自动驾驶的发展进程非常一致。
subtitles.en: Well, first of all, I think this is very consistent to the development process that we have for autonomous driving.

subtitles.zh: 我认为只有当技术达到一定程度，能够产生消费者真正的信任价值和依赖时，商业化才可行。
subtitles.en: I think only when the technology reached a point that, you know, you can generate a consumer, you know, real trust value and dependence, then I think commercialization is feasible.

subtitles.zh: 我们看到，在中国以外，FSD实际上展现出良好的发展轨迹，将软件订阅作为商业模式，因为它在技术上展示了那样的能力。
subtitles.en: We saw, you know, obviously, you know, outside of China, FSD is actually really, you know, showing good trajectory of, you know, getting software subscription as a business model because it displayed that kind of capabilities in technology.

subtitles.zh: 我们非常有信心，明年的扩展显然是预期的改进，国际扩张也将能够展示卓越的自动驾驶能力。
subtitles.en: We are very confident that expand next year was obviously the intended improvement as well as international expansion will be able also to showcase superior autonomous driving capabilities.

subtitles.zh: 因此，对于那个技术水平，我们认为商业模式和商业收入流非常合适，但我们也会为日常正常驾驶保持基础水平的自动驾驶。
subtitles.en: So for that level of technology, we think commercial model and also commercial revenue stream is very appropriate, but we also will maintain a base level of autonomous driving for our, you know, every day, obviously the normal driving.

subtitles.zh: 所以，从高端复杂驾驶条件中获益，我认为一旦展示了技术，就有机会真正看到渗透率在机会和订阅水平上的提升。
subtitles.en: So to appreciate from the high end sophisticated driving conditions, so I think that there's a way I think once you showcase the technology, I think that there's a chance to really see increased in penetration around the opportunity and sub

subtitles.zh: 能多告诉我们一些吗？你提到了一点FSD。你认为你们能比特斯拉的FSD收费更低吗？
subtitles.en: Can you tell us a bit more about, I mean, you mentioned a little bit of FSD. Do you think that you'll be able to charge less than Tesla's FSD?

subtitles.zh: 嗯，我认为目前我们还没有真正讨论确切定价，但也是基于我们所认为的适应性，车辆定价以及订阅定价。
subtitles.en: Well, I don't think at the moment we have really discussed the exact exact pricing yet, but also you're based on what we viewed as sort of the adaptive, the pricing for the vehicle, as well as price pricing for the subscription.

subtitles.zh: 所以这些都还在整合中。我认为大概要到明年第二季度、接近我们推出这类业务模式时，才会有更清晰的图景。
subtitles.en: So all of that is intermind. So I think it will probably have a better picture maybe towards our launch of this sort of business model, maybe around second quarter next year.

briefs.speaker: Brian Gu
briefs.current_title: 小鹏顾宏地：欧洲试驾反响热烈，Robotaxi合作模式揭秘

subtitles.zh: 所以这些都是相互关联的。我认为，可能要到明年第二季度左右，我们推出这种商业模式时，才会有更清晰的图景。你们明年也会把这项技术带到欧洲，VLA 2.0。您如何看待监管机构和欧洲客户的反应，他们是否接受这类技术？
subtitles.en: So all of that is intermind. So I think it will probably have a better picture maybe towards our launch of this sort of business model, maybe around second quarter next year. You're also bringing this technology to Europe, VLA 2.0 next year

subtitles.zh: 或者您认为，面对这类中国技术，他们是否仍有些谨慎？
subtitles.en: Or do you think there are a bit of cautious still when it comes to Chinese technology like this?

subtitles.zh: 我想说，欧洲在高级ADAS功能的采用曲线上确实处于最早阶段。
subtitles.en: Well, I would say Europe is certainly at the earliest stage of the adoption curve for ADAS for high-end ADAS functions.

subtitles.zh: 但真正让我感兴趣的是，我们刚在巴黎为NGP推出了定制试驾，这是我们的自动驾驶技术。
subtitles.en: But actually what I would be very interested is that we just launched our custom test drive in Paris for our NGP, which is the autonomous driving technology.

subtitles.zh: 到目前为止反响很好。我认为消费者对这项技术的接受度实际上要高得多。
subtitles.en: So far the response has been great. And I think we actually had a much better reception to consumers for this technology.

subtitles.zh: 我认为这确实需要定制化的教育，需要大量投入来真正开发商业模式，正如我之前提到的。
subtitles.en: I think actually it is, I would say, something that requires custom education requires a lot of investment in really developing the business model, as I mentioned earlier.

subtitles.zh: 但我认为潜力巨大。如果你看看FSD在某些欧洲市场和澳大利亚的渗透率，这项技术的前景非常可观。
subtitles.en: But I think the potential is huge. And if you see the penetration FSD has in certain European market and also in Australia, I think there's a lot of promises for this technology.

subtitles.zh: 在Robotaxi方面，你们也不打算自己运营车队。
subtitles.en: You're also well in terms of robotaxies, you're not planning to run your robotaxie fleet yourself.

subtitles.zh: 那么能否多谈谈你们的合作伙伴会是谁，以及你们将如何获得收入？
subtitles.en: So can you tell us a bit more about who your partners are going to be and how are you going to get paid?

subtitles.zh: 我认为传统的Robotaxi业务，可以看到有几个参与者：一个是技术提供商，另一个是车辆提供商，还有一个是出行运营商。
subtitles.en: Well, I think the traditional robotaxie business, you can see it from, you know, there's a few players that's involved. One is a technology provider, the other one is the vehicle provider, and the other one is a mobility operator.

subtitles.zh: 对我们而言，我们实际上将技术和车辆合二为一。因此我们成为全球许多出行运营商更容易合作的伙伴。
subtitles.en: For us, we actually combine the technology and vehicle into one. So we actually become a much easier partner for a lot of the mobility operators around the world.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为对我们来说，我们将在全球选定的主要城市建立有趣的合作伙伴关系，我们认为Robotaxi在那里能产生大量价值和需求。
subtitles.en: So I think for us is that we will be, you know, entering into interesting partnerships in select metropolitan cities around the world where robotaxie we think generate lots value and demand.

subtitles.zh: 我们将成为全栈解决方案和车辆提供商，而我们的合作伙伴提供出行服务和运营。
subtitles.en: And we will be the full stack solution and vehicle provider, where our partner provides the mobility services and operations.

subtitles.zh: 我认为当我们真正准备好宣布这些协议时，我们会很乐意与彭博分享。
subtitles.en: I think when we actually have these agreements ready to announce, we'll be happy to share with Bloomberg.

You are a Chinese viral-title angle architect. Return strict JSON only. Do not write a safe summary. Generate competing, fact-grounded emotional angles for each clip. Each candidate must make a viewer feel one strong reaction instead of mild interest. Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.

- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.
- If the source is negative about China-related macro/markets, keep the fact but soften the Chinese wording: talk about pressure, policy response, demand repair, liquidity change, confidence repair, valuation reset, or structural adjustment.
- Never directly use 房价/房價/住房价格/住宅价格/房屋价格/楼市价格 in Chinese output. Preserve the source direction, number, and unit, but paraphrase by context: use 地产市场上行/调整/趋稳/修复 for direction, 居住成本/住房可负担性/置业负担 for affordability, 地产估值 for valuation, and 住宅成交水平 for absolute levels. Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.
- Titles must be sharp but not doom-heavy. Never put 经济危机/金融危机/债务危机/危机 in title, title_lines, title_highlights, comment, or subtitle_comments.
- Title fields must not use financial-advice or product-sale wording such as 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出. Rephrase with neutral market wording such as 资管、配置、权益资产、市场、产品、财富配置、保障、观点.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

briefs.speaker: Brian Gu
briefs.current_title: 小鹏顾宏地：成本压力全行业共担，技术降本如何平衡？

subtitles.zh: 等协议准备好公布时，我们会乐意与彭博分享。好的，我期待。Brian，我想听听你对整体宏观背景的看法，以及我们在AI热潮中所看到的环境。
subtitles.en: I think when we actually have these agreements ready to announce, we'll be happy to share with Bloomberg. Okay, I will look forward to that. Brian, I want to get your take on just the overall macro backdrop, the environment that we're seein

subtitles.zh: 在目前形势下，内存芯片和原材料价格正在上涨。
subtitles.en: You're starting to see memory chips, raw materials are getting more expensive, amidst what's going on.

subtitles.zh: 近期贸易壁垒也在增加。你认为小鹏能消化这些成本，还是现在不得不将部分成本转嫁给客户？
subtitles.en: You have trade barriers that have been rising of late as well. Do you think X-Punk can absorb these costs, or are you going to have to pass on some of these costs to your customers now?

subtitles.zh: 嗯，我认为这是全行业的现象，不仅限于小鹏。
subtitles.en: Well, I think it's an industry-wide phenomena. You know, it's not just limited to expanding packs.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为，面对这种全行业现象，我们会与其他行业参与者同步行动。
subtitles.en: So I think whenever this industry-wide phenomena, I think we will be acting in sync with other industry players.

subtitles.zh: 我认为这是一个充满挑战的市场，周围有所有这些成本问题。
subtitles.en: I think it is a challenging market, with all these costs, issues surrounding us.

subtitles.zh: 但我认为我们确实展现了巨大努力，通过技术开发真正减少影响，
subtitles.en: But I think we have actually shown a tremendous effort to really reduce impacts through technology development,

subtitles.zh: 真正重组了一些功能，改变了产品组合等。
subtitles.en: really retooling some of our features, changing the product mix, et cetera.

subtitles.zh: 所以实际上，我们确实能看到有办法真正缓解部分成本压力。
subtitles.en: So actually, we actually can see there is a way to really alleviate some of these cost pressures.

subtitles.zh: 所以我相信这将是一种平衡的做法。
subtitles.en: So I think I have a confidence that it will be a balanced approach.

subtitles.zh: 我认为我们也会观察并关注整个行业如何应对这种压力。
subtitles.en: And I think also I will say we will observe and monitor how industry as a whole react to that pressure.

subtitles.zh: 是的，Brian，因为你们在做很多事，对吧？整个全栈。你们在资助自动驾驶出租车、人形机器人、飞行汽车。
subtitles.en: Yeah, Brian, because you're doing a lot, right? This whole full stack. You're funding robot taxis, human robots, flying cars.

subtitles.zh: 同时，你们的汽车业务必须帮助支付其中一些账单。
subtitles.en: All the same time, your car business has to help pay for some of these bills.

subtitles.zh: 那么，你预计X-Punk何时能真正实现首个全年盈利？
subtitles.en: When do you expect that X-Punk can actually make its first full-year profit then?

subtitles.zh: 嗯，在我看来，是的，我们正在研究多项技术。
subtitles.en: Well, the way I see it is that, yes, we are working on a number of technologies.

subtitles.zh: 但关键的是，所有这些实际上共享相同的核心，我认为这确实在开发过程中提供了协同效应。
subtitles.en: But the key thing is that all of these actually share the same core, which I think really provides synergy among the development process.

Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.

5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.

- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.

- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.

briefs.speaker: Brian Gu
briefs.current_title: 小鹏顾宏地：机器人毛利高于汽车，明年交付量级可达数万台？

subtitles.zh: 好的，那么Iron在哪些技能上表现更优呢，Brian？拥有汽车业务又有何帮助，无论是通过行程、芯片，还是共享AI和共享工厂？
subtitles.en: Okay, so what sort of skills can Iron do better, maybe Brian? And how does having a car business help, whether it's through sheer trips, chips, I should say, shared AI and shared factories, too?

subtitles.zh: 我认为这些都是优势，因为首先，我们能够开发Iron，实际上是基于我们为智能电动汽车的自动驾驶技术所开发的物理AI核心。
subtitles.en: Well, I think it's all of the buff, because first of all, the reason that we actually are able to develop Iron is actually build upon our physical AI core that we have developed for autonomous driving technology in Smart EV.

subtitles.zh: 如你所知，我们一直在开发全栈能力，拥有自己的芯片、自己的模型、自己的训练工具以及AI基础设施，来训练真正推进模型所需的数据。
subtitles.en: As you know, we have been developing full stack capabilities, actually having our own chip, our own model, our own training tools as well as the AI infrastructure to train the data that necessary for, you know, really advancing the model.

subtitles.zh: 因此，这种能力加上我们作为电动汽车制造商，我们拥有先进的制造能力来管理大型复杂供应链，并理解动力总成的需求，真正以机器人形式呈现。
subtitles.en: So that really, you know, capability coupled with as a EV in our manufacturer, we actually have advanced manufacturing ability to manage large sophisticated supply chain as well as understanding the power train needs to, you know, really in

subtitles.zh: 所以所有这些能力，我认为都与我们的核心电动汽车业务以及我们正在开发的自动驾驶栈非常协同。
subtitles.en: So all of those capability, I would say, a very synergistic to our core EV business as well as the autonomous driving stack that we're developing.

subtitles.zh: 是的，Iron将于明年第二季度上市，Brian，你还说过，在机器人方面，它们实际上可以比汽车获得更高的利润率。
subtitles.en: Yeah, so Iron goes on sale, second quarter of next year, Brian, you've also said that when it comes to robots that they can actually earn higher margins than cars.

subtitles.zh: 你如何看待销量爬坡的形势？你认为机器人何时会成为你收入中更有意义的部分？
subtitles.en: How do you see the volume ramp shaping up? And when do you think robots are going to become a more meaningful part of your revenue?

subtitles.zh: 我认为，明年将是规模扩大和商业化的关键一年。
subtitles.en: Well, I think, you know, next year will be a critical year for scale up and commercialization.

subtitles.zh: 我们预计人形机器人的交付量可能达到数万台。
subtitles.en: We see the delivery potentially in the tens of thousands for human robots.

subtitles.zh: 我们认为机器人的定价将与中等价位的电动汽车相似。
subtitles.en: We see actually robots will be similarly priced to average, shall we say medium priced EV.

subtitles.zh: 但硬件的利润增长要高得多。
subtitles.en: But it was much higher margin growth margin for the hardware.

subtitles.zh: 此外，机器人业务需要大量升级训练和数据基础设施支持。
subtitles.en: But in addition, I would say robot because it requires a lot of the upgrade training as well as data infrastructure support.

subtitles.zh: 我认为除了销售之外，还有可观的收入机会。
subtitles.en: I think there's meaningful revenue opportunities outside of how we're sell.

subtitles.zh: 所以，我认为这是我们看到的业务增长曲线中非常令人兴奋的部分。
subtitles.en: So that's, I would say a very exciting part of the business world's curve that we see.

briefs.current_title: 小鹏顾宏地：智驾订阅收费，技术到位后商业化才可行？

subtitles.en: So that's, I would say a very exciting part of the business world's curve that we see. I want to get your take on autonomous driving as well, because starting from second quarter of next year, your AI smart driving will also become a paid s

subtitles.zh: 能告诉我们为什么决定现在收费吗？你预期怎样的订阅率？
subtitles.en: Can you tell us why you decided to have sort of charging now? What sort of take rate are you expecting?

subtitles.zh: 首先，我认为这与我们自动驾驶的发展进程非常一致。
subtitles.en: Well, first of all, I think this is very consistent to the development process that we have for autonomous driving.

subtitles.zh: 我认为只有当技术达到一定程度，能够产生消费者真正的信任价值和依赖时，商业化才可行。
subtitles.en: I think only when the technology reached a point that, you know, you can generate a consumer, you know, real trust value and dependence, then I think commercialization is feasible.

subtitles.zh: 我们看到，在中国以外，FSD实际上展现出良好的发展轨迹，将软件订阅作为商业模式，因为它在技术上展示了那样的能力。
subtitles.en: We saw, you know, obviously, you know, outside of China, FSD is actually really, you know, showing good trajectory of, you know, getting software subscription as a business model because it displayed that kind of capabilities in technology.

subtitles.zh: 我们非常有信心，明年的扩展显然是预期的改进，国际扩张也将能够展示卓越的自动驾驶能力。
subtitles.en: We are very confident that expand next year was obviously the intended improvement as well as international expansion will be able also to showcase superior autonomous driving capabilities.

subtitles.zh: 因此，对于那个技术水平，我们认为商业模式和商业收入流非常合适，但我们也会为日常正常驾驶保持基础水平的自动驾驶。
subtitles.en: So for that level of technology, we think commercial model and also commercial revenue stream is very appropriate, but we also will maintain a base level of autonomous driving for our, you know, every day, obviously the normal driving.

subtitles.zh: 所以，从高端复杂驾驶条件中获益，我认为一旦展示了技术，就有机会真正看到渗透率在机会和订阅水平上的提升。
subtitles.en: So to appreciate from the high end sophisticated driving conditions, so I think that there's a way I think once you showcase the technology, I think that there's a chance to really see increased in penetration around the opportunity and sub

subtitles.zh: 能多告诉我们一些吗？你提到了一点FSD。你认为你们能比特斯拉的FSD收费更低吗？
subtitles.en: Can you tell us a bit more about, I mean, you mentioned a little bit of FSD. Do you think that you'll be able to charge less than Tesla's FSD?

subtitles.zh: 嗯，我认为目前我们还没有真正讨论确切定价，但也是基于我们所认为的适应性，车辆定价以及订阅定价。
subtitles.en: Well, I don't think at the moment we have really discussed the exact exact pricing yet, but also you're based on what we viewed as sort of the adaptive, the pricing for the vehicle, as well as price pricing for the subscription.

subtitles.zh: 所以这些都还在整合中。我认为大概要到明年第二季度、接近我们推出这类业务模式时，才会有更清晰的图景。
subtitles.en: So all of that is intermind. So I think it will probably have a better picture maybe towards our launch of this sort of business model, maybe around second quarter next year.

briefs.speaker: Brian Gu
briefs.current_title: 小鹏顾宏地：欧洲试驾反响热烈，Robotaxi合作模式揭秘

subtitles.zh: 所以这些都是相互关联的。我认为，可能要到明年第二季度左右，我们推出这种商业模式时，才会有更清晰的图景。你们明年也会把这项技术带到欧洲，VLA 2.0。您如何看待监管机构和欧洲客户的反应，他们是否接受这类技术？
subtitles.en: So all of that is intermind. So I think it will probably have a better picture maybe towards our launch of this sort of business model, maybe around second quarter next year. You're also bringing this technology to Europe, VLA 2.0 next year

subtitles.zh: 或者您认为，面对这类中国技术，他们是否仍有些谨慎？
subtitles.en: Or do you think there are a bit of cautious still when it comes to Chinese technology like this?

subtitles.zh: 我想说，欧洲在高级ADAS功能的采用曲线上确实处于最早阶段。
subtitles.en: Well, I would say Europe is certainly at the earliest stage of the adoption curve for ADAS for high-end ADAS functions.

subtitles.zh: 但真正让我感兴趣的是，我们刚在巴黎为NGP推出了定制试驾，这是我们的自动驾驶技术。
subtitles.en: But actually what I would be very interested is that we just launched our custom test drive in Paris for our NGP, which is the autonomous driving technology.

subtitles.zh: 到目前为止反响很好。我认为消费者对这项技术的接受度实际上要高得多。
subtitles.en: So far the response has been great. And I think we actually had a much better reception to consumers for this technology.

subtitles.zh: 我认为这确实需要定制化的教育，需要大量投入来真正开发商业模式，正如我之前提到的。
subtitles.en: I think actually it is, I would say, something that requires custom education requires a lot of investment in really developing the business model, as I mentioned earlier.

subtitles.zh: 但我认为潜力巨大。如果你看看FSD在某些欧洲市场和澳大利亚的渗透率，这项技术的前景非常可观。
subtitles.en: But I think the potential is huge. And if you see the penetration FSD has in certain European market and also in Australia, I think there's a lot of promises for this technology.

subtitles.zh: 在Robotaxi方面，你们也不打算自己运营车队。
subtitles.en: You're also well in terms of robotaxies, you're not planning to run your robotaxie fleet yourself.

subtitles.zh: 那么能否多谈谈你们的合作伙伴会是谁，以及你们将如何获得收入？
subtitles.en: So can you tell us a bit more about who your partners are going to be and how are you going to get paid?

subtitles.zh: 我认为传统的Robotaxi业务，可以看到有几个参与者：一个是技术提供商，另一个是车辆提供商，还有一个是出行运营商。
subtitles.en: Well, I think the traditional robotaxie business, you can see it from, you know, there's a few players that's involved. One is a technology provider, the other one is the vehicle provider, and the other one is a mobility operator.

subtitles.zh: 对我们而言，我们实际上将技术和车辆合二为一。因此我们成为全球许多出行运营商更容易合作的伙伴。
subtitles.en: For us, we actually combine the technology and vehicle into one. So we actually become a much easier partner for a lot of the mobility operators around the world.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为对我们来说，我们将在全球选定的主要城市建立有趣的合作伙伴关系，我们认为Robotaxi在那里能产生大量价值和需求。
subtitles.en: So I think for us is that we will be, you know, entering into interesting partnerships in select metropolitan cities around the world where robotaxie we think generate lots value and demand.

subtitles.zh: 我们将成为全栈解决方案和车辆提供商，而我们的合作伙伴提供出行服务和运营。
subtitles.en: And we will be the full stack solution and vehicle provider, where our partner provides the mobility services and operations.

subtitles.zh: 我认为当我们真正准备好宣布这些协议时，我们会很乐意与彭博分享。
subtitles.en: I think when we actually have these agreements ready to announce, we'll be happy to share with Bloomberg.

briefs.speaker: Brian Gu
briefs.current_title: 小鹏顾宏地：成本压力全行业共担，技术降本如何平衡？

subtitles.zh: 等协议准备好公布时，我们会乐意与彭博分享。好的，我期待。Brian，我想听听你对整体宏观背景的看法，以及我们在AI热潮中所看到的环境。
subtitles.en: I think when we actually have these agreements ready to announce, we'll be happy to share with Bloomberg. Okay, I will look forward to that. Brian, I want to get your take on just the overall macro backdrop, the environment that we're seein

subtitles.zh: 在目前形势下，内存芯片和原材料价格正在上涨。
subtitles.en: You're starting to see memory chips, raw materials are getting more expensive, amidst what's going on.

subtitles.zh: 近期贸易壁垒也在增加。你认为小鹏能消化这些成本，还是现在不得不将部分成本转嫁给客户？
subtitles.en: You have trade barriers that have been rising of late as well. Do you think X-Punk can absorb these costs, or are you going to have to pass on some of these costs to your customers now?

subtitles.zh: 嗯，我认为这是全行业的现象，不仅限于小鹏。
subtitles.en: Well, I think it's an industry-wide phenomena. You know, it's not just limited to expanding packs.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为，面对这种全行业现象，我们会与其他行业参与者同步行动。
subtitles.en: So I think whenever this industry-wide phenomena, I think we will be acting in sync with other industry players.

subtitles.zh: 我认为这是一个充满挑战的市场，周围有所有这些成本问题。
subtitles.en: I think it is a challenging market, with all these costs, issues surrounding us.

subtitles.zh: 但我认为我们确实展现了巨大努力，通过技术开发真正减少影响，
subtitles.en: But I think we have actually shown a tremendous effort to really reduce impacts through technology development,

subtitles.zh: 真正重组了一些功能，改变了产品组合等。
subtitles.en: really retooling some of our features, changing the product mix, et cetera.

subtitles.zh: 所以实际上，我们确实能看到有办法真正缓解部分成本压力。
subtitles.en: So actually, we actually can see there is a way to really alleviate some of these cost pressures.

subtitles.zh: 所以我相信这将是一种平衡的做法。
subtitles.en: So I think I have a confidence that it will be a balanced approach.

subtitles.zh: 我认为我们也会观察并关注整个行业如何应对这种压力。
subtitles.en: And I think also I will say we will observe and monitor how industry as a whole react to that pressure.

subtitles.zh: 是的，Brian，因为你们在做很多事，对吧？整个全栈。你们在资助自动驾驶出租车、人形机器人、飞行汽车。
subtitles.en: Yeah, Brian, because you're doing a lot, right? This whole full stack. You're funding robot taxis, human robots, flying cars.

subtitles.zh: 同时，你们的汽车业务必须帮助支付其中一些账单。
subtitles.en: All the same time, your car business has to help pay for some of these bills.

subtitles.zh: 那么，你预计X-Punk何时能真正实现首个全年盈利？
subtitles.en: When do you expect that X-Punk can actually make its first full-year profit then?

subtitles.zh: 嗯，在我看来，是的，我们正在研究多项技术。
subtitles.en: Well, the way I see it is that, yes, we are working on a number of technologies.

subtitles.zh: 但关键的是，所有这些实际上共享相同的核心，我认为这确实在开发过程中提供了协同效应。
subtitles.en: But the key thing is that all of these actually share the same core, which I think really provides synergy among the development process.

briefs.speaker_context: Deputy Asia CIO, BNP Paribas Wealth Management
briefs.current_title: 法巴Grace Tam：2027年配置策略，如何分散AI集中风险？

subtitles.zh: 如果我要为2027年构建一个**组合，你会选择哪些资产类别和行业？
subtitles.en: So if I need to construct a portfolio for 2027, what is the classes, what sort of sectors are you looking at now?

subtitles.zh: 我认为仍需分散配置，因为我们并未看到AI的终结。
subtitles.en: Yeah, I think it's still diversification because I mean, we are not seeing like, this is the end of the day of AI.

subtitles.zh: 在AI领域应精挑细选，因为当前市场出现了无差别抛售。
subtitles.en: I think we should be selective in terms of the AI tax because for now you've been seeing sell-off is in this criminate sell-off, right?

subtitles.zh: 无论好公司还是差公司，都遭到抛售。
subtitles.en: Whether it's good companies or bad companies, I mean, they're all sell-off.

subtitles.zh: 未来市场对科技或AI将更具选择性，同时非科技板块如医疗保健或工业公用事业，
subtitles.en: So I think the market will be more selective, going forward in terms of tech or AI, but at the same time of non-tax like health cares or like some of the industrial utilities,

subtitles.zh: 这些应有利于分散风险，但不仅权益资产，跨资产类别如债券市场也有助于分散。
subtitles.en: I think those should be good for diversification, but of course, not only equities is good to diversify across asset classes, like bond markets.

subtitles.zh: 债券市场基金，目前市场情绪偏向避险，
subtitles.en: Yeah, bond market hatch funds, but bond market, for now I think, because I mean, the sentiment is just like favor the safe haven, right?

subtitles.zh: 因此债券市场也出现大幅上涨。
subtitles.en: So for the bond market also have a shut rally.

subtitles.zh: 目前市场似乎完全处于避险状态，当然会回归风险偏好，届时收益率可能再次上升，
subtitles.en: So I think it's better, like for now, the market looks like it's a total risk off and of course, it will get back to risk on and you will see maybe yields going back up again

subtitles.zh: 例如美国10年期国债收益率回升至5%左右，可能是增持债券的好时机。
subtitles.en: and maybe like, for example, like US 10-year fisheries, it's back up to about 5%, maybe that's a good point to accumulate more bonds.

briefs.current_title: 朱光耀：经济转型面临挑战，房地产调整与AI新动能如何平衡？
current_title_lines: 房地产调整与AI新动能如何平衡？

subtitles.zh: 我们清楚，你们预计未来几年，中国仍能将4.5%至5%的增长作为目标。我们有信心，我们认为有经济发展潜力，现在也有实际能力实现这一目标。
subtitles.en: And we clear, you are expecting there to be, in the next couple of years, still we can keep that rate of 4.5 percent to 5 percent growth as a target for China. We have that confidence. We think that we have that's an economic development po

subtitles.zh: 这关乎做大蛋糕，但我们在中国也看到了K型轨迹。
subtitles.en: It's about growing the pie, but what we're also seeing in China is a K-shaped trajectory.

subtitles.zh: 你认为这是需要解决的问题吗？需要修正吗？
subtitles.en: Do you think this is something that needs to be addressed, do you need to fix it?

subtitles.zh: 是的，经济转型中，我们认识到面临的挑战，例如地产行业面临一些挑战。
subtitles.en: Yes, the economic transition, we recognize that the challenge we face, for example, real estate industry faces some challenges.

subtitles.zh: 但我们采取措施加以改善。
subtitles.en: But we do something to make that improvement.

subtitles.zh: 有时，大力发展新模式，即人工智能、现代化产业，这是对中国发展的巨大贡献。
subtitles.en: Sometimes, big effort in new model of development, that's AI, that's modernized industry, that's great contribution to China's development.
